title: Direct conversion of underutilized tropical fruit wastes to 5-hydroxymethylfurfural using a strongly acidic deep eutectic solvent: mechanistic study, renewable extraction, and life cycle assessment
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16491-16504
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01120A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Quang Tam Huynh, Udomsap Jaitham, Hai Nguyen Tran
A sustainable route for producing 5-hydroxymethylfurfural from untreated lignocellulosic biomass is developed using a Brønsted–Lewis superacidic deep eutectic solvent (HBetCl:AlCl3), acting as both solvent and catalyst.
